audit.whatIsWrong: Content twice attributes Soraka's root to her Q (spikes[0].text: "her Q-root follow-up"; wants.foe[1]: "Land her Q root (Starcall)"). Per the kit, Q (Starcall) only slows; the root comes from E (Equinox) — its silence zone roots anyone still inside when it expires.
audit.why: enemyKit flags confirm Q has only a slow flag, while E carries hardCC + silence and its text says targets are rooted when the zone expires.
audit.corrected: Attribute the root to Equinox (E), not Starcall (Q), in both fields.
